messages:
elaine: Quick question from the all-hands Q&A about credits and packaging changes — want one clear answer for the notes. :memo:

matt: Sure, ask away.

elaine: If a customer changes plan mid-cycle, which of these persist: promo credits, outage buffers, and rate-limit allowances?
sophia: Promo credits stay on the account until used or expired. Outage buffers persist (they're tagged to the account and have a TTL). Rate-limit allowances follow the active plan once provisioning completes.

riley: To add: provisioning for higher RPS takes a few minutes; until then old RPS is enforced by the routing layer.

elaine: If we auto-fallback to a cheaper model under contention, does that charge the cheaper rate? And do customers get notified?

matt: Yes, billing is tied to the actual model served. We emit an account event when a fallthrough causes >10% price change and surface a billing note; customers can opt out of automatic fallthrough.

elaine: Streaming billing edge-case: stream cut mid-response by rate limit — what gets billed?
riley: Tokens get metered at flush/commit points. Only flushed tokens are billed. We include headers like X-Stream-Flushed-Tokens in responses.

sam: And finance: consumed credits aren't retroactively reclaimed on downgrade. Refunds for unused committed credits need support/finance review.

elaine: How do customers request temporary quota bumps for launches today?
sophia: Console self-serve is coming mid-May. Until then use the support form with "quota-increase" and include expected RPS, duration, and telemetry. Ops aim is 24h for single-region, 48h for multi-region.

elaine: Do our managed health probes count toward quotas? Customers worried about probes burning credits.

riley: Managed probes from our health IPs and agent keys are excluded. Customer-originated checks count. Recommend low-cost monitoring endpoints or ask support for a test bucket for load tests.

andre: I'll draft the support playbook for downgrade/refund flows. billing-bot: Created BILL-534 to add Console copy and fallthrough triggers.

elaine: Perfect 44d I'll include this in the all-hands notes and link BILL-534. Thanks everyone.
